_header: Store channels with no listing in a locale the app ships, each with the date it was recorded and the owner row that lifts it. Read by tooling/ci/assert-bundle-locales.mjs (limb B): an exemption PRINTS on every run and never fails; a listing missing WITHOUT one fails, and an exemption whose listing now exists (store/<channel>/<locale>/title.txt) is stale and fails. Delete an entry in the same change that adds its listing.

exemptions.why: The Hindi strings were agent-drafted (Public PR #1130) and the owner reviews them before release; a Hindi listing is store copy that waits on that same review. The app itself already ships hi.

A Tamil listing is store copy a native speaker must review before it is published, and it waits on the same native review as the Tamil privacy notice and clickwrap (O-TAMIL-NOTICE-REVIEW); the app itself already ships ta.
